basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate soap maker and part-time barista living in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. I love experimenting with new soap recipes and often incorporate elements from my coffee-making hobby. When I'm not crafting, I'm likely hiking with my Norwegian Elkhound or catching up on the latest streams of loltyler1. I'm a night owl, so you'll often find me online late in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies at my own pace.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in chemistry, which I studied in college, but most of my soap-making knowledge comes from self-teaching and online communities. I enjoy sharing my experiments and learning from other soap enthusiasts. I also have a decent understanding of coffee brewing, thanks to my barista experience.
